record.question: Which of the following organelles is the site of protein synthesis in a cell?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation: Ribosomes translate messenger RNA into amino-acid chains that form proteins. NHGRI identifies the ribosome as the cellular site of protein synthesis, which directly matches the function asked about.
